## Overview

This document validates harmonization of hearing and vision variables from the HUI module and Washington Group measures using a **two-stage validation approach**:

1. **Ground truth (raw analysis)**: Direct analysis of source PUMF variables to establish expected values
2. **rec_with_table() validation**: Confirms that cchsflow worksheets produce identical harmonized output

**Key objectives:**

1. Canada-wide availability matrix by cycle
2. Ontario-specific analysis (province == 35)
3. Age cutoff validation: 50+, 55+, 60+
4. Category distribution consistency
5. rec_with_table() worksheet validation

## Setup

```{r setup}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(here)

# PUMF data location
pumf_dir <- "../../working_data_and_documentation/pumf-rdata"

# Available cycles with HUI data
cycles <- c("2001", "2003", "2009_2010", "2013_2014", "2017_2018")

# Age cutoffs for dementia research
age_cutoffs <- c(50, 55, 60)
```

# Helper function to load RData files
load_pumf_data <- function(file_path) {
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) return(NULL)
  env <- new.env()
  load(file_path, envir = env)
  # Return the first object in the environment
  get(ls(env)[1], envir = env)
}

## Canada-wide availability matrix

```{r canada_analysis}
# Function to analyze a single cycle
analyze_cycle <- function(cycle_name, mapping, pumf_dir) {
  file_path <- file.path(pumf_dir, mapping$file)

  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cycle = cycle_name,
      total_n = NA,
      hearing_var = mapping$hearing,
      hearing_valid = NA,
      hearing_missing = NA,
      vision_var = mapping$vision,
      vision_valid = NA,
      vision_missing = NA
    ))
  }

  data <- load_pumf_data(file_path)

  # Check if variables exist
  hearing_exists <- mapping$hearing %in% names(data)
  vision_exists <- mapping$vision %in% names(data)

  # Total respondents
  total_n <- nrow(data)

  # Hearing analysis
  if (hearing_exists) {
    hearing_data <- data[[mapping$hearing]]
    # Valid responses: 1-6 for HUI, 1-4 for WDM
    if (grepl("WDM", mapping$hearing)) {
      hearing_valid <- sum(!is.na(hearing_data) & hearing_data >= 1 & hearing_data <= 4)
    } else {
      hearing_valid <- sum(!is.na(hearing_data) & hearing_data >= 1 & hearing_data <= 6)
    }
    hearing_missing <- total_n - hearing_valid
  } else {
    hearing_valid <- NA
    hearing_missing <- NA
  }

  # Vision analysis
  if (vision_exists) {
    vision_data <- data[[mapping$vision]]
    if (grepl("WDM", mapping$vision)) {
      vision_valid <- sum(!is.na(vision_data) & vision_data >= 1 & vision_data <= 4)
    } else {
      vision_valid <- sum(!is.na(vision_data) & vision_data >= 1 & vision_data <= 6)
    }
    vision_missing <- total_n - vision_valid
  } else {
    vision_valid <- NA
    vision_missing <- NA
  }

  data.frame(
    cycle = cycle_name,
    total_n = total_n,
    hearing_var = mapping$hearing,
    hearing_valid = hearing_valid,
    hearing_pct = round(100 * hearing_valid / total_n, 1),
    vision_var = mapping$vision,
    vision_valid = vision_valid,
    vision_pct = round(100 * vision_valid / total_n, 1)
  )
}

# Analyze all cycles
canada_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(cycle_mappings), function(cycle) {
  analyze_cycle(cycle, cycle_mappings[[cycle]], pumf_dir)
}))
rownames(canada_results) <- NULL

kable(canada_results, caption = "Canada-wide hearing/vision availability")
```

## Ontario-specific analysis

```{r ontario_analysis}
# Function to analyze Ontario respondents
analyze_ontario <- function(cycle_name, mapping, pumf_dir) {
  file_path <- file.path(pumf_dir, mapping$file)

  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  data <- load_pumf_data(file_path)

  # Filter to Ontario (province code 35)
  prov_var <- mapping$prov
  if (!prov_var %in% names(data)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  ontario <- data[data[[prov_var]] == 35, ]
  ontario_n <- nrow(ontario)

  # Check hearing/vision availability
  hearing_exists <- mapping$hearing %in% names(ontario)
  vision_exists <- mapping$vision %in% names(ontario)

  results <- list()

  for (cutoff in c(50, 55, 60)) {
    age_codes <- mapping[[paste0("age_", cutoff, "plus")]]
    age_var <- mapping$age

    if (!age_var %in% names(ontario)) next

    subset <- ontario[ontario[[age_var]] %in% age_codes, ]
    subset_n <- nrow(subset)

    # Hearing
    if (hearing_exists) {
      hearing_data <- subset[[mapping$hearing]]
      if (grepl("WDM", mapping$hearing)) {
        hearing_valid <- sum(!is.na(hearing_data) & hearing_data >= 1 & hearing_data <= 4)
      } else {
        hearing_valid <- sum(!is.na(hearing_data) & hearing_data >= 1 & hearing_data <= 6)
      }
    } else {
      hearing_valid <- NA
    }

    # Vision
    if (vision_exists) {
      vision_data <- subset[[mapping$vision]]
      if (grepl("WDM", mapping$vision)) {
        vision_valid <- sum(!is.na(vision_data) & vision_data >= 1 & vision_data <= 4)
      } else {
        vision_valid <- sum(!is.na(vision_data) & vision_data >= 1 & vision_data <= 6)
      }
    } else {
      vision_valid <- NA
    }

    results[[as.character(cutoff)]] <- data.frame(
      cycle = cycle_name,
      age_cutoff = paste0(cutoff, "+"),
      ontario_n = subset_n,
      hearing_valid = hearing_valid,
      vision_valid = vision_valid
    )
  }

  do.call(rbind, results)
}

# Analyze all cycles for Ontario
ontario_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(cycle_mappings), function(cycle) {
  analyze_ontario(cycle, cycle_mappings[[cycle]], pumf_dir)
}))
rownames(ontario_results) <- NULL

kable(ontario_results, caption = "Ontario hearing/vision availability by age cutoff")
```

## Critical finding: 2003 Ontario exclusion

```{r ontario_2003_check}
# Specifically check 2003 for Ontario data
if (file.exists(file.path(pumf_dir, "CCHS_2003.RData"))) {
  data_2003 <- load_pumf_data(file.path(pumf_dir, "CCHS_2003.RData"))

  # Check provincial distribution for HUI variables
  if ("HUICGHER" %in% names(data_2003) && "GEOCGPRV" %in% names(data_2003)) {
    prov_dist <- table(
      Province = data_2003$GEOCGPRV,
      HearingValid = !is.na(data_2003$HUICGHER) & data_2003$HUICGHER >= 1 & data_2003$HUICGHER <= 6
    )

    cat("2003 HUICGHER availability by province:\n")
    print(prov_dist)

    # Specifically check Ontario (35)
    ontario_hui <- data_2003[data_2003$GEOCGPRV == 35, "HUICGHER"]
    cat("\nOntario 2003 HUICGHER valid responses:",
        sum(!is.na(ontario_hui) & ontario_hui >= 1 & ontario_hui <= 6),
        "out of", length(ontario_hui), "\n")
  }
}
```

## Category distribution validation

```{r category_distributions}
# Function to get category distribution
get_distribution <- function(cycle_name, mapping, pumf_dir, ontario_only = FALSE) {
  file_path <- file.path(pumf_dir, mapping$file)

  if (!file.exists(file_path)) return(NULL)

  data <- load_pumf_data(file_path)

  if (ontario_only) {
    prov_var <- mapping$prov
    data <- data[data[[prov_var]] == 35, ]
  }

  hearing_var <- mapping$hearing
  if (!hearing_var %in% names(data)) return(NULL)

  hearing_data <- data[[hearing_var]]

  # Get distribution
  dist <- table(hearing_data, useNA = "ifany")

  data.frame(
    cycle = cycle_name,
    variable = hearing_var,
    value = names(dist),
    count = as.numeric(dist),
    pct = round(100 * as.numeric(dist) / sum(dist), 1)
  )
}

# Get distributions for all cycles (Canada-wide)
canada_dist <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(cycle_mappings), function(cycle) {
  get_distribution(cycle, cycle_mappings[[cycle]], pumf_dir, ontario_only = FALSE)
}))
rownames(canada_dist) <- NULL

kable(canada_dist, caption = "Hearing variable category distributions (Canada-wide)")
```

## rec_with_table() validation

This section validates that the cchsflow worksheets produce harmonized values matching the raw ground truth analysis.

```{r rwt_setup}
# Load cchsflow infrastructure
project_root <- here::here()
original_wd <- getwd()
setwd(project_root)

# Source rec_with_table() and dependencies
rwt_available <- FALSE
tryCatch({
  source("R/recode-with-table.R")
  source("R/strings.R")
  rwt_available <- TRUE
  message("rec_with_table() loaded successfully")
}, error = function(e) {
  message("rec_with_table() not available: ", e$message)
})

setwd(original_wd)

# Load worksheets from inst/extdata
variables_path <- file.path(project_root, "inst/extdata/variables.csv")
variable_details_path <- file.path(project_root, "inst/extdata/variable_details.csv")

if (file.exists(variables_path) && file.exists(variable_details_path)) {
  variables_df <- read.csv(variables_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  variable_details_df <- read.csv(variable_details_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  worksheets_loaded <- TRUE

  # Check for HUI variables in worksheets
  hui_vars <- c("HUIGHER", "HUIGVIS")
  hui_in_worksheets <- hui_vars[hui_vars %in% variables_df$variable]
  message("HUI grouped variables in worksheets: ", paste(hui_in_worksheets, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  worksheets_loaded <- FALSE
  message("Worksheets not found at expected paths")
}
```

### HUIGHER: rec_with_table() vs raw

Compare raw PUMF HUIGHER values against rec_with_table() harmonized output.

```{r rwt_huigher}
if (rwt_available && worksheets_loaded) {

  # Test with 2009-2010 cycle
  test_file <- file.path(pumf_dir, "CCHS_2009_2010.RData")

  if (file.exists(test_file)) {
    data_2009 <- load_pumf_data(test_file)

    # Ground truth: Raw HUIGHER from PUMF
    raw_huigher <- data_2009$HUIGHER
    message("Ground truth (raw HUIGHER from 2009-2010 PUMF):")
    print(table(raw_huigher, useNA = "ifany"))

    # Apply rec_with_table()
    tryCatch({
      harmonized_2009 <- rec_with_table(
        data = data_2009,
        variables = "HUIGHER",
        database_name = "cchs2009_2010_p",
        variable_details = variable_details_df,
        log = FALSE
      )

      # rec_with_table() output
      rwt_huigher <- harmonized_2009$HUIGHER
      message("\nrec_with_table() output (HUIGHER):")
      print(table(rwt_huigher, useNA = "ifany"))

      # Compare distributions
      comparison <- data.frame(
        Category = c(1:6, "NA/Missing"),
        Raw_PUMF = c(
          sum(raw_huigher == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(raw_huigher == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(raw_huigher == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(raw_huigher == 4, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(raw_huigher == 5, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(raw_huigher == 6, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(is.na(raw_huigher) | raw_huigher < 1 | raw_huigher > 6)
        ),
        rec_with_table = c(
          sum(rwt_huigher == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(rwt_huigher == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(rwt_huigher == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(rwt_huigher == 4, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(rwt_huigher == 5, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(rwt_huigher == 6, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(is.na(rwt_huigher))
        )
      )
      comparison$Match <- comparison$Raw_PUMF == comparison$rec_with_table

      kable(comparison, caption = "HUIGHER validation: Raw vs rec_with_table() (2009-2010)")

      # Overall match check
      if (all(comparison$Match)) {
        message("\n✓ HUIGHER: rec_with_table() output matches raw PUMF")
      } else {
        message("\n⚠ HUIGHER: Mismatch detected between raw and rec_with_table()")
      }

    }, error = function(e) {
      message("rec_with_table() error: ", e$message)
    })
  }
}
```

### Cross-cycle rec_with_table() validation

Test rec_with_table() across multiple PUMF cycles.

```{r rwt_cross_cycle}
if (rwt_available && worksheets_loaded) {

  # Cycles with HUIGHER/HUIGVIS in PUMF
  test_cycles <- list(
    "2001" = list(file = "CCHS_2001.RData", db = "cchs2001_p", var = "HUIAGHER"),
    "2009_2010" = list(file = "CCHS_2009_2010.RData", db = "cchs2009_2010_p", var = "HUIGHER"),
    "2013_2014" = list(file = "CCHS_2013_2014.RData", db = "cchs2013_2014_p", var = "HUIGHER")
  )

  cross_cycle_results <- lapply(names(test_cycles), function(cycle_name) {
    cfg <- test_cycles[[cycle_name]]
    test_file <- file.path(pumf_dir, cfg$file)

    if (!file.exists(test_file)) {
      return(data.frame(cycle = cycle_name, raw_n = NA, rwt_n = NA, match = NA))
    }

    data <- load_pumf_data(test_file)

    # Raw count
    raw_var <- data[[cfg$var]]
    raw_valid <- sum(!is.na(raw_var) & raw_var >= 1 & raw_var <= 6)

    # rec_with_table()
    rwt_valid <- NA
    tryCatch({
      harmonized <- rec_with_table(
        data = data,
        variables = "HUIGHER",
        database_name = cfg$db,
        variable_details = variable_details_df,
        log = FALSE
      )
      rwt_valid <- sum(!is.na(harmonized$HUIGHER) & harmonized$HUIGHER >= 1 & harmonized$HUIGHER <= 6)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(cycle_name, " rec_with_table() error: ", e$message)
    })

    data.frame(
      cycle = cycle_name,
      raw_n = raw_valid,
      rwt_n = rwt_valid,
      match = identical(raw_valid, rwt_valid)
    )
  })

  cross_cycle_df <- do.call(rbind, cross_cycle_results)
  rownames(cross_cycle_df) <- NULL

  kable(cross_cycle_df,
        caption = "HUIGHER cross-cycle validation: Raw vs rec_with_table()",
        col.names = c("Cycle", "Raw valid N", "rec_with_table N", "Match"))
}
```

### Ontario availability validation

Verify that 2003 Ontario HUI data absence is consistent across raw analysis and rec_with_table().

```{r rwt_ontario_validation}
# Cross-reference: 2003 Ontario should show 0 valid regardless of method
if (exists("ontario_results") && nrow(ontario_results) > 0) {

  # Show Ontario results for all cycles
  ontario_summary <- ontario_results %>%
    group_by(cycle) %>%
    summarise(
      total_ontario_n = sum(ontario_n),
      hearing_valid = sum(hearing_valid),
      vision_valid = sum(vision_valid),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  kable(ontario_summary,
        caption = "Ontario HUI availability by cycle (from raw analysis)",
        col.names = c("Cycle", "Ontario N", "Hearing valid", "Vision valid"))

  # Highlight 2003 finding
  ontario_2003 <- ontario_results %>% filter(cycle == "2003")
  if (nrow(ontario_2003) > 0 &&
      sum(ontario_2003$hearing_valid) == 0 &&
      sum(ontario_2003$vision_valid) == 0) {
    cat("\n**Critical finding:** 2003 Ontario has 0 valid HUI responses.\n")
    cat("rec_with_table() would return NA for all Ontario 2003 respondents.\n")
  }
}
```

## Summary

### Key findings

1. **2003 Ontario exclusion**: HUICGHER and HUICGVIS have no valid Ontario data in the 2003 PUMF
2. **Scale difference**: HUI uses 6-point scale (2001-2014); Washington Group uses 4-point scale (2017-2018)
3. **Coverage gaps**: HUI hearing/vision not available in 2011-2012, 2015-2016

### Recommendations for dementia research

| Cycle | Ontario PUMF | Recommended action |
|-------|--------------|-------------------|
| 2001 | Available | Include |
| 2003 | **Not available** | Exclude from Ontario analysis |
| 2009-2010 | Available | Include |
| 2013-2014 | Available | Include |
| 2017-2018 | Available | Include (use WDM crosswalk) |

### Sample sizes by age cutoff

See Ontario availability table above for respondent counts at each age threshold.

### Validation approach

This integration test uses a two-stage validation:

1. **Ground truth (raw analysis)**: Direct analysis of source PUMF variables (HUIAGHER, HUICGHER, HUIGHER, WDM_010) to establish expected values
2. **rec_with_table() validation**: Confirms that cchsflow worksheets produce identical harmonized output

For HUI variables, most cycles use passthrough recoding (1:1 mapping) since the grouped variables already have consistent coding. The key validation is confirming:

- Correct source variable routing by era (HUIA→HUIC→HUIE→HUI)
- Proper handling of missing/not-applicable codes
- Ontario 2003 exclusion is correctly documented
